title: Wire-Chewer Pack
text: A pack of cable-fed tunnel beasts gnaws at live conduit, twitching with stolen charge and bad decisions.
flavor: They do not know what the wires do. They only know the wires sing.

defeatReward.text: You chase the pack off and salvage a clean stretch of conductor.

imagePrompt: Small lean tunnel beasts chewing glowing cables in a broken machine trench, orange sparks and black iron walls, readable low-tier pack enemy
